title: Entanglement in non-unitary quantum critical spin chains
abstract: Extends entanglement entropy to non-unitary quantum mechanics for quantum-group and supergroup symmetric spin chains. Using left and right eigenstates with appropriate trace definitions gives a natural Renyi entropy, interpreted via loop models, whose conformal scaling distinguishes the central charge from the effective central charge in rational minimal models; also defines an effective central charge in less understood cases (sl(2|1) alternating chain for percolation).
key_claims: Left+right-eigenstate (modified-trace) entanglement entropy scales with the TRUE central charge c even in non-unitary models, while the naive entropy gives c_eff
Introduction names the Yang-Lee fork explicitly: c=-22/5 but c_eff=2/5; RSOS (m,p)=(4,3) is the Yang-Lee class
Lattice numerics (M=400) show both c and c_eff extracted from the same chain
